About Square Lake

Square Lake takes its name from the distinctly rectangular shape visible in aerial views. It's bordered by Tavistock Lakes Blvd, Granger Ave, Briand Ave, and a pedestrian walkway that circles its shore.

What began as a smaller natural wetland (visible in 2008 aerial imagery) was substantially enlarged in 2011 by the Tavistock Group as part of Laureate Park's engineered stormwater retention system, completed 2013–2015.

Today it's a thriving habitat — home to resident alligators, bass, turtles, and the wading birds cataloged in this journal.

Area: 12.53 ac (50,692 m²) Shoreline: 885 m (0.55 mi) Walkway: 962 m (0.60 mi)
